versions.changelog:
- Major redesign: SKILL.md rewritten with comprehensive instructions for updating SenseNova (sn-*) skills in OpenClaw or hermes-agent environments.
- Now supports flexible scope: update all sn-* skills or only specifically named ones.
- Agent targeting clarified—detects OpenClaw/hermes, prompts if both found, halts if neither present.
- Reliable version comparison: upgrade decisions per skill using subtree SHA, release tags, or explicit SKILL.md version.
- Backup improvements: previous skill versions are moved to a timestamped backup folder (max 3 retained), never symlinked or left inside the skills directory.
- Improved error handling and user reporting: summarizes updated, up-to-date, and errored skills separately; offers clear instructions for edge cases.
